issues.on_page: 2710 Vehicle operation and purchasing - regular education 274,894 (p9); fund statement p3 General Fund Student transportation 224,894
issues.issue: Hidden transfer: 50,000 of this line is a transfer that the p3 General Fund column eliminates. It matches the Employee Benefit Fund's 'Transfers from the General Fund' 50,000 (p12), which is also recorded as other financing in detail[78]. The rules for transfers hidden inside spending lines require a split (spending 224,894 + other financing -50,000, with split_from and review). As recorded, the same 50,000 counts as both spending and a transfer.

issues.on_page: 4700 Building improvements 100,000 (p9); p3 General Fund capital outlay 156,985 = Depreciation Fund capital outlay only (p11)
issues.issue: Hidden transfer: p3 has no General Fund capital outlay apart from the Depreciation Fund's 156,985, and 4300 Architecture 8,480 sits in O&M (598,250 = 503,460 + 1,726 + 14,933 + 8,480 + 69,651). So 4700 Building improvements 100,000 is part of the 200,000 transfer to the Depreciation Fund (p11 'Transfers from the General Fund' 200,000, detail[73]). This counts the same money twice; it should be recorded as other financing -100,000 (split_from, review), not as capital outlay spending.

issues.on_page: General Fund instruction lines (1000 Instruction + 3500 State categorical + 6000 Federal programs, p7-9) total 4,060,673; p3 General Fund Instruction 3,960,673
issues.issue: The other 100,000 of the 200,000 transfer to the Depreciation Fund is inside the General Fund instruction lines, and the page doesn't show which line. The rules call for a contra line (section expenditure, -100,000, department instruction, split_from, review) plus an other financing line of -100,000. Neither is there. Hidden transfers total 250,000 (100,000 + 100,000 + 50,000), which matches the gap between the p9 schedule disbursements less the 8000 lines (6,031,633) and the p3 General Fund column less the Depreciation Fund (6,008,269 - 226,636 = 5,781,633). The notes say these transfers 'do not appear as lines in that schedule'; that is incorrect.

The p6 schedule breaks this line down exactly: 1421 312 + 1800 225 + 1920 10,050 + 1925 1,500 + 1955 6,187 + 1980 550 = 18,824. The dominant part is donations/contributions (11,550, 61%), so the line could take that category plus a review naming the mix instead of 'other'.
The p3 fund statement counts this 8,480 under Operation and maintenance of plant, not capital outlay. The category doesn't match the report's own function classification.
